description: Access customer research projects and research material. Use submissions and feedback records as inputs to product research or operational reviews. Organize material by form, project, or topic while retaining links to the original records and their context. Distinguish the collected sample from the wider user population and check for duplicate submissions or missing information. A small set of responses should not automatically be generalized into a conclusion about all users.
description_cn: 访问用户研究项目及研究资料。适合将收集到的意见和提交资料整理成产品研究或运营复盘的输入。可围绕表单、项目或反馈主题归纳返回记录，保留原始条目与上下文以便进一步查看。分析时应区分样本范围与总体用户，注意重复提交和缺失信息，避免从少量反馈直接推导普遍结论。
